exposure: Intrathecal 0.5% hyperbaric levobupivacaine with 1 mg nalbuphine
Intrathecal 0.5% hyperbaric levobupivacaine with 5 microg dexmedetomidine
cohort: 60 parturients undergoing elective Lower Segment Cesarean Section were included in the study.
finding: The intrathecal combination of 5 microg dexmedetomidine and 0.5% hyperbaric levobupivacaine provides significantly faster onset and prolonged sensory and motor blockade with enhanced perioperative analgesia compared to nalbuphine 1mg.
